text:
maria: Pre-cutover check for EU midnight slice. Need roles, escape hatch, and smoke owners. Who's taking signalboard? :eyes:
release-bot: Scheduled deploy at 00:00 UTC. Canary A -> 5% for 15m, then 25% if green. Pin v3.4.1 to prod.
simon: I'll take signalboard. I'll watch error-rate and latency dashboards.
alice: On-call here. I'll be rollback lead — will trigger rollback playbook if errors > 1.5% sustained for 10m.
paul: Observability + smoke tests. I'll run the post-deploy synthetic checks and watch traces.
teju: I'll handle DB migrations and prewarming. Quick runbook:
```
# prewarm kv cache
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/prewarm -d '{"env":"prod","keys":"slice-eu"}'
# smoke check
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-worker -n prod --timeout=5m
```
devops-bot: Smoke run started (build #9876). Logs: https://ci.redwood/build/9876 :white_check_mark:
maria: Escape hatch rules — list them here so we can reference during deploy:
- immediate rollback if 1) error-rate >1.5% and increasing OR 2) p50 latency doubles
- manual unpin allowed by release lead + oncall
- emergency hotfix branch if rollback causes data regressions
simon: Noted. Signalboard channel will be #release-war-room and I'll post minute-by-minute updates.
paul: Smoke is green on canary A, traces show kv hit-rate 98%.
teju: Canary warmup done, migration ran in 2s, no lock contention.
release-bot: Pin applied: prod -> v3.4.1. Fallback configured to v3.4.0 for capacity or perf regressions.
alice: Setting auto-unpin timer: 20m after deploy if manual ack not received. I'll keep a clock on it.
maria: I've posted the release notes and checklists here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RD-3212 — add anything missing.
paul: Added observability playbook link and smoke run output.
simon: Final call — green to proceed? :thumbsup:
paul: +1
teju: +1
alice: +1 (oncall ready)
release-bot: Deploy started. Canary A traffic routed.
maria: Going live. Keep updates short and status-first (OK/WARN/FAIL). If anyone sees FAIL, ping @alice immediately.
simon: Canary OK at 5%. Monitoring for 10m.
devops-bot: Canary metrics: error-rate 0.4%, p50 latency +8%.
paul: Observability: traces look clean, no new error signatures.
alice: Watching. If error-rate >1.5% for 2 consecutive 5m buckets, I'll run rollback.
simon: Canary promoted to 25%. All green so far.
maria: Thanks team — will call a postmortem if we hit any regressions. Otherwise, quiet rollforward starting at +40m. :rocket:
